name: crt.sh
description: Search certificate identities and fingerprints to surface names worth investigating.
caveat: A certificate is not proof of current DNS, ownership, or an accessible service.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Censys Platform
description: Pivot across indexed hosts, certificates and web properties using current CenQL.
caveat: Legacy Search syntax is not interchangeable with CenQL. Historical banners do not prove a vulnerability.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Shodan
description: Read indexed service observations and build a passive picture of an authorized network.
caveat: Coverage, observation time and plan affect results. A search hit is not permission to connect.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: urlscan.io
description: Explore existing scan records, redirect chains and resources without submitting a new scan.
caveat: Search existing records first. New submissions can disclose URLs; unlisted is not private.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: RIPEstat
description: Put an IP address in routing context and compare prefix and ASN history.
caveat: Routing relationships describe infrastructure, not necessarily the operator of a hosted site.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Cloudflare Radar
description: Examine network-level traffic and outage observations with a clear collection vantage point.
caveat: Cloudflare observations are a view of the Internet, not a census of every network.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Common Crawl Index
description: Find crawl-index records and discover historical paths outside ordinary search results.
caveat: A crawl may be incomplete. Use the columnar index for bulk work; do not hammer the CDX service.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Wayback Machine
description: Build a timeline of captured pages and compare changes in public claims.
caveat: Capture time is not publication time. Replayed pages may contain resources captured on different dates.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: ArchiveWeb.page
description: Capture an interactive page as you browse, then retain a replayable web archive.
caveat: Capture can contact the target and include private session data. Review and redact before sharing.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: ReplayWeb.page
description: Replay captured web archives without treating a screenshot as the entire evidence record.
caveat: Replay quality depends on what was captured; absent elements are not proof they never existed.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Companies House
description: Anchor UK corporate research in company numbers, filings and document images.
caveat: The register warns that it does not check the accuracy of filed information. Corroborate material claims.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: GLEIF LEI Search
description: Resolve legal entities and examine reported parent-child relationships using stable LEIs.
caveat: A missing relationship can reflect a reporting exception. LEI coverage is not every company.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: SEC EDGAR
description: Trace public-company disclosures and retrieve submission histories by CIK.
caveat: Filings are issuer statements. Check amendments, reporting periods and the original filing.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: OpenSanctions
description: Use multi-attribute matching to find candidate records and follow their upstream sources.
caveat: A name match is not an identity conclusion. Check identifiers, dates, jurisdiction and the original list.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: TED Procurement
description: Explore procurement notices and connect suppliers, award notices and contracting authorities.
caveat: A contract notice is not necessarily an award. Track notice type and subsequent corrections.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: OCCRP Aleph
description: Cross-reference documents and entities, then inspect the underlying dataset and provenance.
caveat: Access is reviewed for Aleph Pro. Dataset membership is not evidence of wrongdoing.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Wikidata Query Service
description: Bridge identifiers and explore structured relationships with SPARQL.
caveat: Community-maintained statements can be incomplete. Follow statement references, not just the graph.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: OpenAlex
description: Map scholarly works and affiliations using identifiers rather than ambiguous names.
caveat: Entity resolution and affiliations can be wrong. Verify against original publications and persistent IDs.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Crossref Metadata Search
description: Resolve a work from title or DOI and inspect publisher-deposited metadata.
caveat: Deposited metadata is not a quality judgment. Confirm corrections and retractions with the publisher.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: NASA FIRMS
description: Compare satellite fire and thermal-anomaly detections against an event window.
caveat: A hotspot alone does not establish a cause. Account for sensor resolution, cloud and detection time.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Overpass Turbo
description: Turn combinations of map features into a bounded candidate-location search.
caveat: Uses OpenStreetMap data, so agreement with OSM is not independent corroboration. Avoid global heavy queries.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: OpenStreetMap
description: Compare roads, waterways and public landmarks against visible scene geometry.
caveat: Map completeness and edit dates vary. Do not infer an event date from a current map.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: SunCalc
description: Test whether a candidate place and time are consistent with observed sunlight.
caveat: Requires defensible location, orientation and geometry. Many different dates can produce similar shadows.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: ExifTool
description: Read image and document metadata locally before uploading an artifact anywhere.
caveat: Metadata is editable and may be stripped. Inspect a working copy and preserve the original hash.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: GDELT
description: Find multilingual reporting and compare coverage across a defined time window.
caveat: Syndicated stories are not independent sources. Automated event extraction can misclassify a report.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: OONI Explorer
description: Inspect existing network measurements when investigating reachability or possible blocking.
caveat: An anomaly is not automatically censorship. Compare networks, controls and measurement dates.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Hugging Face Model Cards
description: Trace a public model card, declared datasets and linked repositories at a specific revision.
caveat: Cards are author claims, not proof of training provenance. Do not execute untrusted model artifacts.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Open Source Insights
description: Explore dependency graphs and resolve package-version context before drawing supply-chain conclusions.
caveat: Resolved dependencies can differ by environment and lockfile. A package name is not a unique identity across ecosystems.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: OSV.dev
description: Join package versions or commits to published vulnerability records and their primary references.
caveat: An advisory match is not proof of reachability or exploitability in a particular deployment.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: GitHub Code Search
description: Search public source using repo, org, path and content qualifiers; pin evidence to a commit.
caveat: Code search is not complete Git history. Stay within scope and never test discovered credentials.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.

name: Bellingcat Toolkit
description: Find specialist tools with context about requirements, limitations and investigative use.
caveat: A toolkit points to sources; it is not independent evidence for an investigation.

review.scope: Publisher page or documentation reviewed. Service functionality, prices and every query were not live-tested.
